video_title: Jared McCain on Tonight's Game | Postgame Media | November 22, 2026

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on the team's depth and competitive culture
quotes.excerpt: a lot of it is just playing free. And I think the coaches, the staff, has a good job
quotes.quote: I think we all know one through whatever it is, 18 with the two-ways, that we all can play and that we all can go out there and just compete. A lot of it is just playing free. And I think the coaches, the staff, has a good job of letting us do that, especially people who don't get as many minutes. They still can go out there and be confident, and for us that's huge. We need everybody to be just as confident as they are, no matter what the situation is. For us to go out there and try to just be us, be ourselves, stick to our principles, that was good to watch.
quotes.social_post: Jared McCain on the Thunder depth: I think we all know one through 18 that we all can play and that we all can go out there and just compete. It is huge for us to have everyone be confident no matter the situation.

structured.context: Jared McCain discusses the team's depth and the coaching staff's role in maintaining player confidence.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on learning from new defensive challenges
quotes.excerpt: anytime you get to experience something where there's something new like that, it's you can learn from it
quotes.quote: It's definitely good for experience. Anytime you get to experience something where there's something new like that, it's you can learn from it and build from it. You see how, I mean it was just a little bit, but you see how Shai gets guarded every night in certain aspects. So, just learning. There's always room to learn no matter what time of life, whatever part of life you're in. I try to use whatever they're throwing at me. They did a lot of switching tonight, so being able to look at the film for teams that switch more and just adjust from there. I never take anything as a failure or any as a something negative. I try and just keep it as a learning possibility, a learning curve, whatever it is, and move forward with that in a positive direction.
quotes.social_post: Jared McCain on learning from defensive schemes: You see how Shai gets guarded every night in certain aspects. I never take anything as a failure. I try and just keep it as a learning possibility and move forward in a positive direction.

structured.context: Jared McCain reflects on learning from defensive challenges and observing how Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is guarded.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on his development as a playmaker and defender
quotes.excerpt: being able to make plays off read off closeouts, and deliver the ball in certain ways
quotes.quote: I think just decision making. Since I got drafted, since college too, I've always been that spot-up shooter. And so being able to make plays off read off closeouts, and deliver the ball in certain ways that I wasn't used to, I'm just learning different ways I can play. It's good for me, it's good for the team. I think a lot of the players are learning new stuff about themselves. But for myself, I think just decision making has been huge and defensively, that I can guard bigger guys and learn more on my defensive side.
quotes.social_post: Jared McCain on his growth: Since I got drafted I have always been that spot up shooter. Being able to make plays off read off closeouts and deliver the ball in ways I was not used to is good for me and good for the team.

structured.context: Jared McCain discusses his personal development in decision making and defensive versatility.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on Micic's opportunity in the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: it shows that the coaches trust him, and for long-term I think it's going to be huge for us
quotes.quote: It's huge. I think one of those things that builds a lot of confidence in him. It shows that the coaches trust him, and for long-term I think it's going to be huge for us. During this stretch, it's a lot of learning. And so when players that are injured start to come back more, it's going to be us all being confident and just trying to look at it in a positive direction. Having everyone be confident in themselves towards the end of the season is what we need.

structured.context: Jared McCain comments on Vasilije Micic receiving an opportunity in the starting lineup while other players are injured.
